headline:
لعبة Girls und Panzer
تصل إلى PS5 وإلى Steam
label: رسمي
sound_note: trailer music stem (audio split, music_only) under the whole cut; whisper on the full trailer audio: no speech

angle.hook: the anime tank game Girls und Panzer is no longer a Switch 2 exclusive: PS5 and Steam join, dated 25 March 2027
angle.why_now: D3 Publisher's site lists all three platforms and the date; Gematsu reported it 13 Nov 06:05 Dubai
angle.what_it_means_here: Steam means Gulf PC players can buy it, but the release is stated for Japan only, Japanese language, no Arabic
angle.payoff: over 90 characters in new art, story mode with an original story, 6,980 yen

showcase_reason: case a: the news is the new trailer itself, which shows the three platform logos and the date

reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: headline تصل إلى + platforms; the date sits in the strip as a fact, no bare تصل for a date

decision_log: shot 0 (8.6 s): the protagonist running through the anime's town, moving and recognisable; starts after the slate wipe (the first server render caught the pink wipe on frame 0 at 8.0 s, and the 0 to 3.8 s tank stretch showed the slate), so it starts later
shot 1 (12.6 s) and 2 (16.0 s): the street walk with the town caption, then the street with a tank; both for the exploration lines
shot 3 (30.1 s) and 4 (33.0 s): a battle shot, then the three platform logos with the crossplay caption; the trailer proves nothing about performance
shot 6 (44.0 s): group art of the 90 plus characters, the payoff
crop: showcase layout, full frame at its own width so the burnt-in Japanese captions and logos are never cropped
music: trailer music stem via the split, music_only, continuous from 0.0 s
